decision: Stage-separated external diagnosis; preL unscored, synchronization and incomplete per-sample genotype evidence retained.
Independent mixed LZ and pachytene comparators only; six whole-testis RNA and ten small-RNA profiles excluded.
Inspected public barcode information has raw_file/processed_file/cell/barcode only; no explicit fine stage labels in that file. Atlas expression deferred; no stage inferred from cell names.
GEO sample labels identify enrichments, not per-cell leptotene. Annotated Loupe data mentioned by paper require separate audit; no atlas ingested.
